The exit signature was a confluence, not a single trigger: giveback jumped from 0% to 15% in one bar, 5m volatility spiked (+7.3), ER10 hit 1.00, and KMDR/CLIMAX/PROPP all flipped to firing against the position simultaneously after PROPP had been firing with us on the way up.
